_doc: Per-model prices used ONLY to turn measured token counts into an API-equivalent cost: the Usage line of the review report, `prr usage`, `prr stats` and `prr score`. Claude API list prices in USD per 1M tokens; subscription plans are not billed per token, so treat cost as a relative yardstick. The values are a snapshot: check current prices on the provider's pricing page and update as_of (the date printed next to costs). Editing this file does not re-price runs already in the metrics log, and the built-in starting values of the `prr plan` estimate (scripts/lib/metrics.mjs) do not follow it. Matching: a model id uses the longest key in models that it starts with, otherwise the first families pattern (a regular expression) that matches it; tokens on a model that matches neither are reported as unpriced - add the model here. cache_multipliers multiply a model's input price for 5-minute cache writes, 1-hour cache writes and cache reads; a model entry may give its own cache_read price instead.
